title: Contains Artificial Sweetener
description: Contains Artificial Sweetener — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: TDA Agent Anise Rawgers

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Trapse through Lower Balzack's Burrow looking for samples of the new Sweetener. Bring the samples you find back to Anise Rawgers in Balzack's Burrow Base Camp.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: TDA Agent Anise Rawgers

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Sugar-Coating the Truth

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Trapse through Lower Balzack's Burrow looking for samples of the new Sweetener. Bring the samples you find back to Anise Rawgers in Balzack's Burrow Base Camp.

Offer:

This. Is. Delicious! No, seriously, this is the second-best thing I have ever tasted. What's the most delicious thing? The Abysmal Candy that Abaddon has been pumping out--real shame what happened to Wally Wanka and all, but Abaddon's candy is incredible. This coffee is so good now, it tastes just like Abysmal Candy but with a slight aftertaste of burnt Whisker fur.

...

Well enough about the Abysmal Candy. We need to know what this sweetener is. It doesn't seem like a normal sweetener. No, this sweetener is different. Different, yet so familiar. I need samples of the stuff to be sure. The Demonspawn in Lower Balzack's Burrow are probably carrying extra sweetener with them. Go out and get some samples, then bring them back to me, the TDA Agent Anise Rawgers in the Balzack's Burrow Base Camp.

Turn-in:

Thank you for assisting the TDA in this matter, Dungeon Runner. Here is your reward.

Now if you will excuse me, I need to examine this sweetener a bit more closely. I should have the results and your next assignment very soon.

Objectives:

  • Samples of ''Sweetener'' ×25

Client level range: 55–100
